whoIsDibodev.question: Who is Dibodev?
whoIsDibodev.answer: Dibodev is the company of Léo Guillaume, a freelance full-stack developer based near Rennes, France, in Saint-Erblon. Since 2025, he has been building custom business apps, management software, websites and AI automations for small and medium businesses.

services.question: What services do you offer?
services.answer: Custom business apps and management software (scheduling, inventory, quotes and invoices, time tracking, online booking), SaaS products, fast and well-ranked websites, and AI integration in your tools.

area.question: Where do you work?
area.answer: In Rennes and across Ille-et-Vilaine, where I can travel for important meetings, and remotely across France for projects that allow it.

price.question: How much does a project cost?
price.answer: Every project comes with a free fixed-price quote. For a custom business app, the budget is usually between €5,000 and €15,000, then €100 to €300 per month for maintenance.

process.question: How does a project work?
process.answer: A free first call to understand your needs, a clear quote with the scope, price and stages, deliveries in stages so you can test the tool as we go, then launch, onboarding and maintenance.

technologies.question: Which technologies do you use?
technologies.answer: Mainly Nuxt, Vue.js and TypeScript, with Node.js, Python or .NET on the server depending on the project, and AI models to automate repetitive tasks.

price.question: How much does custom business software cost?
price.answer: At a fixed price, between €5,000 and €15,000 for most small business tools (scheduling, inventory, quotes, time tracking). The price depends on the number of screens, users and connections to your software; a more complete platform can cost more. It is set in the quote before we start, and maintenance then costs €100 to €300 per month depending on the tool.

delay.question: How long does it take to build the tool?
delay.answer: The timeline is set in the quote depending on the scope. I deliver in stages: you use a first version quickly, then the tool grows with your feedback.

freelance.question: Why a freelancer rather than an agency?
freelance.answer: You talk directly to the person who designs and builds your tool, from the first call to maintenance. Fewer intermediaries, faster decisions and a price without agency overheads.

area.question: Do you only work in Rennes?
area.answer: I am based near Rennes and travel within Rennes, Ille-et-Vilaine and Brittany when useful. I also work remotely with businesses across France.

excel.question: Can you take over our Excel files?
excel.answer: Yes. I import the data from your existing files into the new tool, so your team does not start from scratch.

existing.question: What if existing software is enough?
existing.answer: I will tell you on the first call. Custom software only makes sense when off-the-shelf tools do not fit the way you work.

story.title: Who am I?
story.background: My name is Léo Guillaume. Before writing code, I worked as a cook for five years. In 2020, I turned software development into my job by joining the Web{'@'}cadémie at Epitech Rennes as a work-study student, then went on to earn a master's degree in AI and data.
story.career: Since then, I have built tools people use every day: three business apps at Kodeva, still running in small and medium businesses, then the Izidoor booking platform, now used by around thirty sports and leisure organizations.
story.dibodev: In 2025, I founded Dibodev to work directly with small and medium businesses. My goal: replace spreadsheets, paperwork and repetitive tasks with simple tools designed for the people who use them.
story.ai: Since April 2026, I have also been on a mission for PrePeers, an EdTech startup that uses artificial intelligence to help 15 to 25-year-olds choose their path. I build the platform and the AI chats that guide students, all the way to partner schools' websites.
story.workingStyle: I work alone, in direct contact with you, from the first call to maintenance. Every project has a fixed price with a clear quote, and is delivered in stages so you can test the tool as the project moves forward.
